abilities.name: PUTRESCENT PIETY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice . If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, give this unit D3 ritual points .

abilities.name: SEEDS OF ROT
abilities.effect: When using the ‘ Blessed by the Plaguefather ’ ability, if you choose to infect an enemy unit, you can pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective that is seeded with rot .

abilities.name: BLOOMING PLAGUE
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is seeded with rot for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: RETCHLING
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit’s Fecula Flyblown is on the battlefield, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FECULA FLYBLOWN
abilities.effect: While this unit’s Fecula Flyblown is on the battlefield, it has WIZARD ( 1 ) .

abilities.name: RIDDLED WITH DISEASE
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the ‘ Rally ’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non- HERO unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

abilities.name: ROT-BLOSSOM
abilities.effect: Friendly ROTBRINGERS units have WARD ( 5+ ) while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature

abilities.name: TENDRILS OF CORRUPTION
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature . Designer’s Note: This terrain feature cannot use MOVE , RUN , RETREAT or CHARGE abilities.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: EVERYONE ABOARD!
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly INFANTRY HERO and up to 1 friendly non- reinforced , non- HERO INFANTR y unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s passengers . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THIS IS YOUR STOP, MAGGOTS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit’s passengers to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets’ melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: GODMARKED LEGION
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown gains the ‘Gifts of Chaos’ ability and one of the following faction keywords that matches your army’s faction: BLADES OF KHORNE DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE HEDONITES OF SLAANESH

abilities.name: GIFTS OF CHAOS
abilities.effect: If this unit has the BLADES OF KHORNE keyword, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Hellforged Weapons and its Hellforged Weapons have the Blood-Hungry weapon ability. If this unit has the DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH keyword, it has WIZARD ( 1 ) . If this unit has the MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE keyword, it has WARD ( 5+ ) . If this unit has the HEDONITES OF SLAANESH keyword, add 1 run rolls and charge rolls for it.

abilities.name: FICKLE MOTIVES
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK units while you have more victory points than your opponent. Subtract 3 from the control score s of friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK units while you have fewer victory points than your opponent.

abilities.name: ALWAYS THREE CLAWSTEPS AHEAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use the ’ Normal Move ’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: SKRYRE PAYLOADS
abilities.effect: Friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK Doom-Flayers units have WARD ( 5+ ) while they are within the combat range of a friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK Stormvermin unit.

abilities.name: IRONCLAD DESPOILERS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown while they are contesting an objective you control. Add 1 to wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown while they are contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: MASKED IN PLAIN SIGHT
abilities.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve incognito . It has now been deployed. Friendly incognito units are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round

abilities.name: BAIT AND SWITCH
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is incognito . Pick this unit and a friendly INFANTRY HERO to be the targets. One target must be incognito and the other must be on the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up the incognito target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat . Then, remove the other target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve incognito . If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly incognito unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.

abilities.name: FORCEFUL COMMAND
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: The target cannot use MOVE abilities. The target’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) .

abilities.name: LURKING THREAT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if none of those units have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve lurking in the mists . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THE MISTS PART
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if they are lurking in the mists .
abilities.effect: Set up the Shardspeaker of Slaanesh in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the Blissbarb Archers unit in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Shardspeaker of Slaanesh , wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHAKE THE EARTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is INFANTRY , double the amount of mortal damage inflicted. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: TIMBERRRRR!
abilities.effect: When the MEGA-GARGANT in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off . The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly NON-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit: You can re-roll run rolls for the target. Add 1 to charge rolls for the target. The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks . Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks . Add 10 to the target’s control score .

abilities.name: DIRGE OF DESOLATION
abilities.declare: Pick the Ashen Elder in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick another terrain feature to be a second target.

abilities.name: ALL-CONSUMING SEARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Ashen Elder in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability. Then, pick an objective or Place of Power that they are contesting and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 5+, give this unit 1 ritual point .

abilities.name: SPLINTERS OF SORCERY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target does not have the ‘ Place of Power ’ terrain ability, it gains that ability for the rest of the battle. If the target has the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability, pick an enemy unit within 12" of it and roll 9 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: BUBBLES OF UNREALITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature with the ‘ Place of Power ’ terrain ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time a friendly WIZARD in this Regiment of Renown uses a SUMMON SPELL ability this phase, you can measure the range and visibility of that SPELL ability from the target instead of from the caster.

abilities.name: SPEW FORTH SIN
abilities.declare: Pick the Contorted Epitome in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn. If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation , set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Mesmerising Mirror , set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: SPARKS OF PROFANE POTENTIAL
abilities.effect: If the Magister in the Regiment of Renown has been deployed, set up one of the following MANIFESTATIONS within 1" of them: 1 Burning Sigil of Tzeentch 1 Tome of Eyes 1 Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: SKILLED SUMMONER
abilities.declare: Pick the Magister in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the MANIFESTATIONS from the list below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6: 1 Burning Sigil of Tzeentch 1 Tome of Eyes 1 Daemonic Simulacrum
abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished . Then, set up the MANIFESTATION you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that MANIFESTATION is a Daemonic Simulacrum , it must also be set up more than 9" away from all enemy units.

abilities.name: FLICKERING WYRDFLAME
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points inflicted on it this turn by WYRDFLAME SPELL abilities or attacks made with weapons that have the WYRDFLAME weapon ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BOLT OF TZEENTCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Magister in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: REINFORCE DAEMONSTEEL
abilities.declare: Pick the Daemonsmith in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly HELSMITHS OF HASHUT unit in each phase while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: DISPLAY OF TOTAL POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If neither WAR MACHINE unit in this Regiment of Renown used any SHOOT abilities this turn, pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: While that enemy unit is on the battlefield, the WAR MACHINE units in this Regiment of Renown can only pick that enemy unit to be the target of their shooting attacks . Each of those WAR MACHINE units counts as if it had 3 daemonic power points . The first time you use this ability, you can use it without any command points being spent.

abilities.name: HATRED FOR ALL
abilities.declare: You must use this ability if this unit is not in combat and there are any other visible friendly units within this unit’s combat range . You must pick 1 of those friendly units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks for this unit against the target.

abilities.name: FRENZIED VIOLENCE
abilities.declare: Pick the Slaughterpriest in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target unit has WARD ( 5+ ) while every model in that unit is wholly within the combat range of an enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: GLIMPSE THE GOD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by the target’s combat attacks this turn, that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, and no damage points were allocated to that enemy unit this turn by combat attacks made by a friendly unit that is not in this Regiment of Renown, for the rest of the battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s Blood-hungry weapons.

abilities.name: BEHOLD MY GENIUS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick all friendly VOLT-KLAW’S ENGINECOVEN units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks . Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.

abilities.name: HIDE-SHELTER!
abilities.effect: While a friendly VOLT-KLAW’S ENGINECOVEN INFANTRY unit is within the combat range of a friendly VOLT-KLAW’S ENGINECOVEN Ratling Warpblaster , it is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

abilities.name: FAVOUR OF THE GODS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If any enemy HEROES were slain this turn by the Gunnar Brand in this Regiment of Renown : Heal (5) each unit in this Regiment of Renown. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BESTIAL DOMINATION
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a unit in this Regiment of Renown
abilities.effect: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: GO DAT WAY!
abilities.declare: Pick the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is within 12" of the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can still use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: TAKTIKAL COWERING
abilities.effect: While the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown: That Loonboss has WARD ( 4+ ) . Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Loonboss , allocate 1 damage point to that Dankhold Troggoth after the damage sequence for that Loonboss has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: A DELUDED QUEST
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN keyword.

abilities.name: A QUEST WELL DONE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If the enemy ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN unit is destroyed by a unit in this Regiment of Renown , add 10 to the control score of each unit in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: PROJECTILE VOMIT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick all other units (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BELLOWING MOCKERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’RE YOU LOOKIN’ AT?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.
